items.heading: Sarson da Saag with Makki di Roti
details: Key ingredients: mustard greens, spinach, maize flour, ginger, garlic, ghee
Cook mustard greens and spinach with ginger and garlic until soft.
Mash coarsely and simmer with a little maize flour to thicken.
Knead maize flour into a dough and pat into flatbreads, cooking on a hot griddle.
Serve the saag topped with a dollop of ghee alongside the makki roti.

items.heading: Amritsari Chole
details: Key ingredients: chickpeas, tea bags, onion, tomato, chole masala
Soak and boil chickpeas with a tea bag for a deep dark color.
Saute onion, ginger-garlic and tomato into a thick masala base.
Add the boiled chickpeas and simmer until the flavors meld.
Finish with chole masala and serve with bhature or kulcha.

items.heading: Punjabi Butter Chicken
details: Key ingredients: chicken, tomato puree, butter, cream, kasuri methi
Marinate and grill or roast chicken pieces until charred.
Simmer tomato puree with butter until it reduces into a rich sauce.
Add the cooked chicken and simmer in the sauce.
Finish with cream and a pinch of crushed kasuri methi.

items.heading: Kachri ki Chutney
details: Key ingredients: wild kachri melon, mustard seeds, red chili, salt
Roast or boil wild kachri melon until soft.
Grind with dried red chili, salt and a touch of cumin into a coarse chutney.
Temper mustard seeds and asafoetida in oil.
Pour the tempering over the chutney and mix well before serving.
